messages.author: 47e7aa9b192efc0d
messages.subject: iOS 7 - Safari - iPhone / iPad
parts:
Hello All,

We are working on the following shiny app... http://spark.rstudio.com/gsdesign/prod/

We test it mostly on our desktops (Macs and Windows).
But we did periodically test it on our iPhone/iPads.

Before iOS 7, in Safari, on both iPads and iPhones, everything rendered as expected...looked great.
Now, using iOS 7.0.2, in Safari, the above link does not render results.
In iOS 7.0.2, using Chrome, on both the iPad and iPhone the above link does render results.

Just wanted to see if anyone else is having a similar experience with Safari in iOS 7.x.x.

Please write if you know of any issue between shiny and iOS 7.x.x

All the best,

John Lueders
